{{Top|leg}}
The '''Murakami orchid''', also known simply as a '''black orchid''', was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] from the [[Murakam system/Legends|Murakam system]].

The plant was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] with a high [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorian]] count. It was said to bond only with people who had a similar concentration of midi-chlorians, and could "speak" with the bonded person (usually a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]) telepathically. It required the bonded Jedi to be near it in order to survive, and during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the Jedi would house these flowers in an incubator to survive without the bonded Jedi's presence in the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] facility at [[Marfa]].

Jedi Agricultural Corps member [[Hestizo Trace]] formed a bond with a Murakami orchid, but the plant ultimately proved to be a danger when [[Darth Scabrous]] used it to create a [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|virus]] for the purpose of [[Zombie/Legends|eternal life]]. The serum was found in an ancient [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] found in a sanctum in the base of the academy's library.
